title: mentha × muelleriana subsp. stachyoides
intro: Mentha × muelleriana subsp. stachyoides, commonly known as Mentha stachyoides, is a subspecies of hybrid mint plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Mentha stachyoides include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which make it useful for treating various conditions such as headaches, fever, and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
